get.description: Returns the priorities of the sources of the current user that have data of the metric type or are in its stored priorities: their order, the ignored ones and the combine mode. Without stored priorities, the order is the default one. An uncurated type without samples of the user answers 404. Accepts a session or a token with the `read` scope.

parameters.description: The key of the metric type.
parameters.name: type

get.summary: Get the source priorities of a metric

put.description: Stores the order of the sources of the metric type, the ignored ones and the combine mode, and returns the priorities as GET does. The aggregates of the type are recomputed: series show `updating` until then. A source of another user answers 422 `source_unknown`, a source listed twice, ordered and ignored included, 422 `source_listed_twice`, and the combine mode on a type that is not discrete 422 `combine_not_discrete`.

parameters.description: The key of the metric type.

put.summary: Set the source priorities of a metric

post.description: Replaces the password of the user of the reset link, marks the link used and revokes every session of the user, who then logs in with the new password. The token is in the body so that it never reaches a log. A link used, expired, unknown, replaced by a newer one or of an account being deleted answers 410 `reset_link_invalid`. A password that breaks the rules answers 422 with the code of the rule: `password_too_short`, `password_too_long` or `password_too_common`, and the link stays valid. It needs no authentication.

get.description: Tells whether the instance has no user yet, so that the first admin must be created with the setup token. It needs no authentication.

post.description: Creates the first admin with the setup token, opens their session and sets the session cookie. Once a user exists, whatever the token, it answers 409 `setup_completed`. A wrong token answers 403 `setup_token_invalid`. A username or password that breaks the rules answers 422 with the code of the rule: `username_invalid`, `password_too_short`, `password_too_long` or `password_too_common`.

schema.description: The session cookie.

get.description: Returns the devices and apps that produced data of the current user, with their sample count. Accepts a session or a token with the `read` scope.

patch.description: Renames a source of the current user, or sets its kind, and returns the source. A new display name recomputes nothing. A new kind recomputes the aggregates of the metric types that the source has samples of, since it places the source in their priorities: series show `updating` until then. A source of another user answers 404.

parameters.description: The id of the source.
parameters.name: id

schema.description: The id of the source.
